outputs.explanation: Panel A is a sequence conservation logo (information content per position), not a plot of averaged/aggregated data with error bars, so individual data points are not applicable.
Inhibition zone percentages are shown as mean ± SEM bars with individual gray dots overlaid, as stated in the caption and visible in the plot.
Panel C consists of microscopy images, not a data plot.
Fluorescence intensity is shown as mean ± SEM with individual yellow dots representing single cells, as described in the caption and visible in the panel.
Fluorescence intensity is shown as mean ± SEM with individual blue dots representing single cells, as described in the caption and visible in the panel.
Panel F shows super-resolution localization images, not an averaged data plot.
Number of clusters per cell is shown as mean ± SEM with individual gray dots for each cell, as stated in the caption and visible in the panel.
Cluster sizes are shown as mean ± SEM with individual gray dots for each cluster, as stated in the caption and visible in the panel.
Proportion of molecules in clusters is shown as mean ± SEM with individual gray dots for each cell, as stated in the caption and visible in the panel.
